claim: A widely circulated 'Epstein wasn't the asset' thesis bundles a set of mostly-known claims about the Epstein-Maxwell operation. Tested against the record: (1) Ghislaine Maxwell is the youngest daughter of Robert Maxwell, who was buried on the Mount of Olives in Jerusalem on Nov 10 1991 with serving and former Israeli intelligence leadership in attendance — documented in contemporaneous UPI/JTA/Washington Post wire reporting and the long-standing Hersh/Gordon-Thomas Mossad-tie literature ([[1991-maxwell-funeral-001]]). (2) An October 2020 FBI Los Angeles field-office memo, released in early 2026 as part of the DOJ Epstein files, recorded a confidential human source close to Alan Dershowitz stating his belief that Epstein 'was a co-opted Mossad agent' trained as a spy by former Israeli PM Ehud Barak — this is a real FBI-generated document, but a record of a source's belief rather than a corroborated FBI finding ([[2020-fbi-epstein-mossad-memo-001]]). (3) Les Wexner's documented relationship with Epstein began in the mid-1980s; in July 1991 Wexner granted Epstein power of attorney and a trustee seat on the Wexner Foundation, allowing Epstein to hire, sign checks, buy/sell properties, and borrow money on Wexner's behalf — the foundation of Epstein's later 'billionaire' presentation. Between 1987 and 2007 Wexner retained Epstein as his financial manager. The specific extension — that Wexner 'may have funded 9/11' — is not supported in any released document, primary or secondary. (4) The claim that Epstein was one of 'fifty Mossad pedophilia entrapment operations across the United States' with '49 others, all of them protected by the FBI' has no documented basis in any FOIA release, congressional record, or court filing the project has been able to locate; the 'fifty operations' number has been repeated in talks across 2018-2020 without any primary citation. (5) The claim about 27 states passing anti-BDS laws making boycott calls a felony is well-documented but with nuance: 38 states have anti-BDS measures of varying severity, and most operate as state-contract restrictions and pension-fund divestment rules rather than felony criminal statutes ([[2017-anti-bds-laws-001]]).
